retainedChange.description: Reuse replacementUri when saving a redirect whose redirectedSavePath is already supplied. Existing helper fast path handles ordinary paths; unusual paths keep its URIjs fallback.

rejectedChange.description: Skip inline CSS processing if /url|@import/i finds no marker.
rejectedChange.reason: Many-static-style fixture uses fewer sampled allocation bytes, but MDN shows no clear gain and URL-bearing styles show approximately 2.8% more sampled allocation normally. Extra scan not adopted.

scope: MDN and styles measurements describe the exploratory candidate with both changes. Redirect saving invokes only the retained changed function; its source matches the final tested subset. No new MDN speedup claimed.

environment.host: Shared host; no idle wait; timing suites sequential and separate from profiling.
environment.dependencies: Unchanged physical packages; no Cheerio, URIjs or parser replacement.

allocation.pressure: JavaScript arrays retained up to 2 MiB. Totals include identical harness churn.

measure-next.sh.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
source /mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/env.sh
for suite in mdn redirect; do
 for kind in normal pressure; do
  for mode in timing profile; do
   node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 /mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/harness/compare-final.mjs "$suite" "$kind" "$mode" > "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/logs/$suite-$kind-$mode.log" 2>&1
  done
 done
done
for kind in normal pressure; do
 node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 /mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/harness/compare-final.mjs styles "$kind" timing > "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/logs/styles-$kind-timing.log" 2>&1
done
export WSE_FOCUSED_CASES=style-static,style-links
for pressure in 0 1; do
 export WSE_HEAP_PRESSURE=$pressure
 for round in 0 1 2; do
  for k in 0 1 2; do
   variant=$(( (k + round) % 3 ));name=next
   if [ "$variant" = 0 ]; then name=current; fi
   node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=128 --max-semi-space-size=4 /mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/harness/style-profile.mjs "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/variants/$name/lib/index.js" profile "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/profiles/style-p$pressure-r$round-v$variant" > "/mnt/e/tmp/wse-fuzz-next-20261004/logs/style-p$pressure-r$round-v$variant.json"
  done
 done
done
